entries.zh: 丢掉；把某物丢放别处（丢弃）
entries.en: to throw something away somewhere; to discard
entries.notes: 第三字原件标注〔疑：棄/處〕，按丢、放两字及对音取'棄'。

entries.en: to throw something downward; to toss it down here
entries.notes: 首字原件标注〔疑：擦/擲〕，按'落来'取掷落之义。

entries.en: to throw it in(to some place); to toss

entries.zh: 投水；投入水中（旧亦指投水自尽）
entries.en: to throw into the water; to drown oneself (投水)
entries.notes: '投水'为熟语，兼指投水自尽；西语 arrojarle al agua 泛指抛入水中。

entries.zh: 投井；投入井中（旧亦指投井自尽）
entries.en: to throw into a well; to drown oneself in a well (投井)
entries.notes: '投井'为熟语，兼指投井自尽；西语义泛指抛入井中。

entries.en: to throw out (logs, pieces of wood); to fling
to throw far away; to discard (desechar)

entries.zh: 拾而弃之；撇弃、丢开（某物）
entries.en: to pick up and cast away; to throw something out
entries.notes: 西语 'por tiendo' 字样难解（疑为讹写或缩写），义依汉字栏'捻却摈'（拾起弃去）定夺。

entries.en: to throw something down; to toss down
entries.notes: 第二字原件标注〔疑：捺/换〕，按'放捺'取丢掷置放之义。

entries.en: to throw away; to cast off
entries.notes: 第三字原件标注〔疑：摈/損〕，取'摈'以合弃掷之义。

entries.en: to throw away; to discard
to abandon; to discard (desechar)
to throw away; to cast off
entries.notes: M 栏首有 '+' 记号（疑为呼应前条或订正符号），不影响释义。

entries.en: to fling away by opening/scattering
entries.notes: 首字原件标注〔疑：發/撥〕，按 abriendo（开启）取'撥'（拨），撒开抛掷。

entries.en: to hurl; to dash or throw (at)
entries.notes: 首字原件标注〔疑：撞/常〕，按对音 zòng 取'撞'。

entries.en: to hurl at; to throw toward
to throw it upward; to hurl up
entries.notes: 首字〔疑：撞/常〕，取'撞'；'上去'即向上抛去。

entries.en: to throw it downward; to hurl down
entries.notes: 首字〔疑：撞/常〕，取'撞'；M 栏尾 'abayo' 系西语 abaxo 混入。

entries.en: to throw canes or bamboo slips at someone
entries.notes: 西语 'mandarinong canas ¥ guoacufen' 难解（疑含他加禄语成分或杂写）；两汉字均标〔疑〕，按 cañas（竿、签）取'掷签'之义。

entries.en: to scatter; to sow (broadcast)
entries.notes: M 栏作两音节 'Io: Poā'、R 栏单音节 pō，释义同取'播撒'。

entries.en: to scatter about; to strew and cast away
entries.notes: 第三字原件标注〔疑：摈/損〕；R 栏尾附注 '(Bong hiin)' 未解，不影响本义。

entries.en: to spread out; to scatter (derramar)
to sow seed; to scatter seed

entries.zh: 打倒掷弃；撞击而丢弃（倒却摈）
entries.en: to throw striking or knocking down; to cast away
entries.notes: 首字〔疑：到/倒〕，按 baciando（=batiendo 击打）取'倒'；西语 'obot viendo' 疑为 'o botando'（或掷倒）之讹。

entries.en: to throw striking; to knock against
entries.notes: 两字均标〔疑〕（到/倒、挨/换），依 baciando（击打）取'倒、击'之义。

entries.zh: 扫除；倒掉垃圾（扫除废物）
entries.en: to sweep away; to throw out refuse (basura)
